_meta.description: Tenders and contract packages for Line 5, Line 5A included. Values in crore INR. 'tender_status' is floated, bids_opened, awarded, cancelled or unknown. Only packages whose source was read are listed. Notices that MMRDA itself issued (its website, its notices on mahatenders.gov.in, its AIIB procurement notices) are graded verified. Search of 30 Oct 2026: the portal's archive and award lists do not hold Metro PIU's own packages, so most rows come from MMRDA notices or trade press.

tenders.scope: Part design and construction of the viaduct and stations from Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka, 12.811 km
tenders.notes: Other bidders included Larsen & Toubro and NCC. The report gives no contract value.

tenders.scope: Kasheli depot: stabling yard, sheds, workshops, operation control centre, administrative building and staff quarters
tenders.awarded_value_note: Lowest bid Rs 597.56 crore (March 2023), 26.6% above the estimate; awarded at Rs 589.56 crore.

tenders.scope: Supply of about 6,800 t of head-hardened rails for Lines 5 and 9
tenders.notes: The Metro Rail Guy's contractor list for Line 5 (updated 14 Sep 2025): cancelled, with JSPL the only bidder. Floated again as CA-203. No date or value found.

tenders.scope: Ballastless standard-gauge track from Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka (Phase 1) and the depot line near Kasheli
tenders.notes: 5 bidders (The Metro Rail Guy, 6 Apr 2023); Paras Railtech lowest bidder in May 2023; letter of award at Rs 97.40 crore in the report's February 2024 update. The report calls this stretch 'Line 5A', an older name for Phase 1; it is not today's Line 5A spur.

tenders.scope: Supply of about 6,800 t of head-hardened rails for Lines 5 and 9 (second call after CA-159)
tenders.notes: The Metro Rail Guy's contractor list for Line 5 (updated 14 Sep 2025): cancelled, with JSPL again the only bidder. No date or value found.

tenders.scope: General consultant for Phase 2, Bhiwandi to Kalyan
tenders.notes: The Metro Rail Guy's contractor list for Line 5 (updated 14 Sep 2025): cancelled. Floated again as CA-256. No date or reason found.

tenders.scope: Overhead electrification, power supply, traction, electrical and mechanical works, lifts and escalators
tenders.notes: 4 technical bids in November 2024; IRCON International lowest bidder in February 2025, reported as 15.42% above MMRDA's estimate. Reports give Rs 428 crore (estimate) and Rs 494 to 497 crore (IRCON's bid); which figure is which is not clear, so none is shown. No award notice found.

tenders.scope: Rolling stock (22 six-car trains), CBTC signalling and train control, telecom, platform screen doors, and depot machinery at Kasheli
other_bidders: CRRC Nanjing Puzhen (technically non-responsive; financial bid not opened)
tenders.notes: MMRDA's contract award notice, signed 6 Nov 2025: selection by lowest evaluated cost; contract price INR 1,725.91 crore plus USD 89.46 million (equivalent Rs 2,481 crore); ready for operation in 108 weeks for Phase 1 and 200 weeks for Phase 2, GoA4 commissioning in 217 weeks; 7 years of comprehensive maintenance from GoA2 commissioning of Phase 1, including the defect period. The notice still names Phase 2 as Dhamankar Naka to Kalyan APMC (the 2017 plan). Bids invited in February 2024 at an estimate of Rs 2,640.72 crore; letter of acceptance announced on 31 Oct 2025.

tenders.scope: Automatic fare collection for Phases 1 and 2, with 15 years of maintenance after a 2-year defect period
tenders.notes: MMRDA's specific procurement notice, published by AIIB (international open tender, single stage, two envelopes). Documents from 20 Mar 2024 to 6 Jun 2024; bids due 26 Jun 2024 3:00 PM; tender security Rs 1.744 crore; 46 months to design and build, then 17 years of maintenance including the 2-year defect period. No bidders or award found.

tenders.scope: Architectural finishing and pre-engineered steel at the 6 elevated Phase 1 stations
tenders.notes: The Metro Rail Guy's contractor list for Line 5 (updated 14 Sep 2025): awarded to the NACPL-Mansi-UCC joint venture. No date or value found.

tenders.scope: General consultant for Phase 2, Dhamankar Naka to Kalyan APMC (13.02 km of viaduct, including 3.5 km underground; the 2023 plan)
tenders.notes: The Metro Rail Guy's contractor list (updated 14 Sep 2025) shows bidding under way. Tender listings give bid opening on 11 Jun 2024 and later mark it expired. No award found. The route it describes was replaced by the 2026 plan.

tenders.scope: Multi-modal integration facilities at the 6 Phase 1 stations, Balkum Naka to Dhamankar Naka
tenders.awarded_value_note: Awarded bid Rs 52,32,60,734.52; the portal gives a total contract value of Rs 54,20,98,120.42.
tenders.notes: Award of contract summary on the Maharashtra e-procurement portal (Results of Tenders), MMRDA Transport and Communication: bids closed 8 Jul 2024; contract date 4 Dec 2024; 365 days; 2 covers; manual letter of award. Read 30 Oct 2026.

tenders.scope: Project management consultant to supervise and monitor the multi-modal integration works at the 6 Phase 1 stations
tenders.notes: Award of contract summary on the Maharashtra e-procurement portal (Results of Tenders), MMRDA Transport and Communication: bids closed 21 Aug 2024; contract date 22 Sep 2025; Rs 1,35,00,000; 365 days; manual letter of award. Read 30 Oct 2026.

tenders.scope: Signage graphics and station furniture (design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning) at the six elevated Phase 1 stations
tenders.notes: Better Thane (@MH04Thane) on X, 15 Apr 2026, with drawings from the tender: area maps, the network and fare-zone maps, exit signs, and station signs such as Balkum Naka's, numbered 501. Package number CA-311 (ref MMRDA/MPIU/ML5/CA-311, tender ID 2026_MMRDA_1295210_1) and a value of about Rs 11.56 crore come from tender aggregator listings (infralens, publicservicesmap), with a corrigendum of 1 May 2026; not checked on the portal, so the value is not shown. Bidders not found.

tenders.scope: Standard-gauge track work (ballasted and ballastless) at the Kasheli depot
tenders.notes: Free Press Journal (June 2026): about Rs 84.34 to 84.35 crore, 20 months including the monsoon; pre-bid meeting 10 Jun 2026; bids due 30 Jun 2026. Reports give the bid security as Rs 42.17 lakh or Rs 4.22 lakh. The tender ID is from aggregator listings. No bidders or award found.

tenders.scope: General consultant for the civil works of Line 5A (Durgadi to Kalyan with a spur to Ulhasnagar), 48 months
tenders.notes: On the Maharashtra e-procurement portal's Cancelled list (read 30 Oct 2026): tender ID 2026_MMRDA_1283742_1, published 4 Mar 2026, bids due 25 Aug 2026, opening 28 Aug 2026. Cancelled by a notice dated 19 Aug 2026 (@Maha7Arindam's reply of 31 Aug 2026). First floated in 2025: a photo of MMRDA's newspaper notice, posted by Artful Dodger (@RahulChels) on X on 24 Sep 2025, gives EMD Rs 37 lakh, cost of tender Rs 3,540 including GST, pre-bid meeting 10 Oct 2025, documents from 1 Oct 2025, last date 14 Nov 2025. The 2026 issue's key plan (posted by @Maha7Arindam, 5 Mar 2026) is the source of the Phase 3 and spur route.

tenders.scope: Phase 2, Dhamankar Naka to Rajnoli Junction (ch. 12,200 to 17,860): design and construction of the viaduct, cut and cover, open ramp and tunnel, with 1 underground and 1 elevated station (excluding architectural finishing and pre-engineered steel)

chainage_m.zero: main line, as in the Phase 1 environmental report (Sep 2023)

tenders.notes: MMRDA's notice on the Maharashtra e-procurement portal, published 29 Oct 2026 6:50 PM. Lump-sum, 2 covers. Tender fee Rs 11,800 plus Rs 500 processing; EMD Rs 90 lakh. A date corrigendum moved the document download start to 5 Nov 2026 3:00 PM; bids close 30 Nov 2026 3:00 PM and open 2 Dec 2026. The tender spells it 'Rajnouli Junction'. Ch. 12,200 is the east end of the built Dhamankar Naka station (its centre is ch. 12,125.6 in the environmental report, and the deck is about 145 m). The two stations are matched to Bhiwandi (underground) and Temghar by MMRDA's press release of 28 May 2026; the notice does not name them. Free Press Journal (13 Jul 2026) reported a first call for bids on 11 Jul 2026 with the same split at Rajnoli Junction and 48 months to complete.

tenders.scope: Phase 2 and Phase 3, Rajnoli Junction to Bhoirwadi (ch. 17,860 to 26,140): design and construction of the elevated viaduct, the viaduct integrated with a road flyover, a creek bridge, connecting road ramps and 7 elevated stations (excluding architectural finishing)

chainage_m.zero: main line, as in the Phase 1 environmental report (Sep 2023)

tenders.notes: MMRDA's notice on the Maharashtra e-procurement portal, published 30 Oct 2026 10:00 AM. Lump-sum, 2 covers. Tender fee Rs 11,800 plus Rs 500 processing; EMD Rs 72 lakh. Pre-bid meeting 17 Nov 2026 3:00 PM at MMRDA, BKC. A date corrigendum moved the document download start to 5 Nov 2026 3:00 PM; bids close 30 Nov 2026 3:00 PM and open 2 Dec 2026. The creek bridge is the crossing of the Ulhas into Durgadi. The 7 stations are matched by MMRDA's press release of 28 May 2026 and the March 2026 key plan; the notice does not name them. The end, ch. 26,140, meets CA-314 Part A at its ch. 3,596, so the Phase 3 chainage starts at about main-line ch. 22,544.

tenders.scope: Line 5A. Part A (ch. 3,596 to 6,521 of Phase 3): elevated viaduct and 1 elevated station. Part B (ch. 383 to 5,272 of the spur): elevated viaduct with an integrated road flyover and 3 double-decker elevated stations

chainage_m.zero: Phase 3, from the Ulhas river bridge, as in the March 2026 key plan
Line 5A spur, from Bhoirwadi, as in the March 2026 key plan

tenders.notes: MMRDA's notice on the Maharashtra e-procurement portal, published 30 Oct 2026 10:00 AM. Lump-sum, 2 covers. Tender fee Rs 11,800 plus Rs 500 processing; EMD Rs 67 lakh. A date corrigendum moved the document download start to 5 Nov 2026 3:00 PM; bids close 30 Nov 2026 3:00 PM and open 2 Dec 2026. The chainages match the March 2026 key plan: Part B ends at ch. 5,272, the spur's length on the key plan (5,272.630 m), so its 3 stations are Shanti Nagar, Shivaji Chowk and Ulhasnagar. Part A starts past Bhoirwadi (key plan ch. 3,330) and ends before Kalyan (6,557.185), so its station is Shivaji Path (5,290). Kalyan station is not in this package. The notice does not name the stations.
